Choose the black-arrow Pick tool. Left-click the rectangle outline.
On the right palette, LEFT-click the No Color (×) swatch. Use the mouse, not the X key.
RIGHT-click red. If the whole shape turns red, press Ctrl+Z and try the right button. Use the line width your teacher specifies.
Move each copy apart so identical cutting outlines do not overlap.

Select the front wall; Ctrl + D
This makes the back wall: another 80 × 46 mm rectangle.
Make two more copies. Set each to 56 × 46 mm for the left and right walls.
Press F6. Draw 80 × 60 mm with no fill and a red outline. Duplicate it once. You now have six panels.

W1 front wall: engrave doors and windows

Window: 8 × 8 mm
Door: 10 × 16 mm
Keep every line inside the wall.
Draw a rectangle, 8 × 8 mm. Left-click No Color; right-click blue.
Use the Pick tool to move it
Place it near the top of the front wall. Press Ctrl+D and move each copy apart. Stay at least 3 mm from outer edges.
Use a blue outline near the bottom of the front wall. Leave at least 3 mm below it. You may design your own door and window layout.
07 | Align windows at the same height
Finish entering numbers before selecting objects and using alignment keys.
Form 2 wooden buildings | CorelDRAW 2019 | 2 mm wood
After: all three centres are at the same height
Click a window to move. Hold Shift and select another. Select the correctly placed reference window last.
Their centres move to the same height. Do not include the wall in the selection: it could move too.
Click blank space, then select one window with the Pick tool. Hold Ctrl while dragging sideways to keep its height. Undo with Ctrl+Z.
Finish all six panels first. The templates do not contain text.

Save another copy and convert its text to curves.
Type a short sign, such as MY SCHOOL. Switch to the Pick tool to move it.
Keep the sign inside the wall
Use a blue outline, or the engraving method your teacher specifies. Keep clear of doors, windows and outer edges.
Convert text in the submission copy
Save an editable copy, then a submission copy. Select the text and press Ctrl+Q. You cannot directly edit the wording after conversion.
One complete model = quantity 1. Do not use the number of panels as the quantity.

Form 2 wooden buildings | CorelDRAW 2019 | 2 mm wood
Find front, back, left, right, roof and base. The front wall has the door. Do not glue yet.
2 | Put four walls on the base
Fit the side walls between the front and back walls. Hold them with tape. Check that all corners are square.
The roof should cover all four walls. If it fits, glue the joints one at a time. Let the glue dry before stacking boxes.
Roof does not fit? Check that side walls sit between front and back walls, and that you have not used the roof as a wall.
Follow your teacher when using hot glue or tools. Do not touch hot glue or material while the laser is working.
